channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Alia Bhatt's daughter Raha makes tricolour card, SRK-Priyanka Chopra join chorus of patriotism on Republic Day
item.description: Alia Bhatt, Akshay Kumar, Kamal Haasan, Chiranjeevi, Suniel Shetty, Smriti Irani, Rupali Ganguly, Ronit Roy, and Mrunal Thakur paid tribute to the brave sons of the nation and celebrated India's freedom and bravery.

item.title: K'taka tableau reflects journey from 'millets to microchips' at Bharat Parv
item.description: The Karnataka tableau themed 'Millets to Microchip' was showcased at Bharat Parv 2026 at the Red Fort as part of Republic Day celebrations. Displaying the state's journey from traditional agriculture to a technology-driven economy, the tableau highlights millet production, rural empowerment, industrial growth and technological innovation.

item.title: Budget 2026: Industry expectations anchored in policy continuity, credibility, execution
item.description: Against global uncertainty and a calibrated fiscal consolidation path towards a deficit of about 4.4 per cent of GDP, Budget 2026 is being read as a signal of India's medium-term economic intent, according to Grant Thornton Bharat's 'Pre Budget Survey 2026'.

item.title: Presence of EU leaders at R-Day celebrations underscores growing strength of partnership: PM Modi
item.description: European Council President Antonio Costa and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen attended India's 77th Republic Day celebrations as Chief Guests, describing it as a "spectacular celebration" of India's history and cultural diversity. Leyen highlighted the display of EU flags and military contingents, including the ATALANTA and ASPIDES missions, as a symbol of deepening security cooperation with India, culminating in the upcoming Security and Defence Partnership.

item.title: Sun Pharma, Cipla recall medicines in US over manufacturing issues
item.description: Separately, Cipla's US subsidiary recalled more than 15,000 pre-filled syringes of Lanreotide Injection due to the presence of particulate matter. This was classified as a Class II recall, which may cause temporary or reversible health effects. The recalls highlight the importance of strict quality and regulatory compliance in the US, the world's largest pharmaceutical market.

item.title: Operation Sindoor not just military action, but India's strategic resolve: LG Sinha
item.description: Addressing the gathering after unfurling the National Flag in Jammu, Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha said Operation Sindoor marked a defining shift in India's security doctrine. He said India has conveyed globally that terror attacks will be met with firm and lawful retaliation, while honouring security forces and martyrs who safeguarded national sovereignty.

item.title: Border 2 success: Varun Dhawan's fans pour milk on his poster, netizens call it PR stunt; actor reacts
item.description: A video showing milk being poured over a poster of Varun Dhawan from Border 2 has not gone down well with netizens. Many expressed outrage over the milk wastage and slammed the PR team for the initiative, with some even calling it cringe and a God-like obsession. However, amid the backlash, Varun Dhawan thanked his fans for showering love on his role in the film.

item.title: Palash Muchhal removes 'SM18' tattoo, deletes Smriti Mandhana posts two months after wedding called off
item.description: While Smriti removed their pictures together from her social media soon after the wedding was cancelled, Palash initially made no changes to his profile. Netizens have now noticed that Palash Muchhal has deleted all photos featuring Smriti Mandhana from his Instagram account.

item.title: J&K's Simran Bala creates history, leads CRPF men's contingent at Republic Day Parade
item.description: Twenty-six-year-old Simran Bala from the Rajouri district of Jammu and Kashmir created history by leading the CRPF men's contingent at the Republic Day parade in New Delhi. The first woman from her district to join the officer ranks of the CRPF, Bala's achievement has become a moment of pride for border communities and an inspiration for young girls.

item.title: Haryana emerges overall champion of Khelo India Winter Games 2026; Army retains ice-hockey gold
item.description: The Indian Army men's team retained their ice hockey gold medal at the Khelo India Winter Games 2026 in Leh, edging past a resilient Chandigarh side 3–2 in a thrilling final at the Nawang Dorjan Stobdan Stadium, as Haryana topped the overall medal standings in the Ladakh phase of the Winter Games.
